nodes.label: Turnitout-Core Engine & 8-Node Cluster Architecture
nodes.author: Ahmad Hassan
nodes.rationale: Deployed across an 8-node Streamlit Cloud cluster spanning seven GitHub accounts to guarantee high availability and bypass CPU/RAM throttling during viral spikes.

nodes.label: Universal Push Protocol (sync_cluster.sh)
nodes.rationale: Code changes must always be pushed to all 8 cluster repositories so worker mirrors remain 100% in sync with origin.

nodes.label: Single Source of Truth Config (configs/global_config.json)
nodes.rationale: Maintains VIP whitelisted_users and traffic_balancing settings in a single JSON file without separate config files for sub-features.

nodes.label: Strict Lazy Model Loading & File Watcher Invariant
nodes.rationale: Prevents Python 3.14 sys.modules KeyError crashes by disabling Streamlit fileWatcherType and avoids 400MB cold-start memory allocation before authentication.
